svg.aria-label: The same setting with the proposed approach in place. The professional keeps a tabbed record whose pages are tied by threads to their sources. At the automated screen a checklist card shows which evidence was used and what is missing, an auditor with a clipboard stands beside the corridor, the recruiter holds a short list with reasons, the pages reach the hiring manager nearly whole and the calendar shows fewer months.
svg.title: The proposal: evidence tied to its sources passes the same gates nearly whole
